ideas.pitch: A localized logistics platform that uses predictive demand modeling to route surplus dining hall food to Atlanta community fridges before expiration.
ideas.title: Atlanta Campus Food Rescue Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: It targets local social impact in Atlanta, which appeals heavily to university-hosted hackathon judges looking for tangible community value.

ideas.pitch: A privacy-first multi-agent RAG system built specifically on Emory Student Health guidelines to triage symptoms and route students to campus mental and physical health resources.
ideas.title: Emory Student Health RAG Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced multi-agent orchestration and addresses an acute, relatable problem for students attending Emory University.

ideas.pitch: An interactive GIS spatial analysis tool combining MARTA public transit schedules with socioeconomic census data to highlight transit deserts around university areas in Atlanta.
ideas.title: MARTA Transit Equity Mapper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages geospatial data visualization, which immediately captures judges' attention with compelling, high-contrast visual outputs.

ideas.pitch: An automated compliance and anomaly detection platform for student government association allocations using lightweight graph intelligence to flag suspicious spending patterns.
ideas.title: Campus Club Budget & Grant Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an administrative pain point experienced directly by student organizers and campus faculty judges.

ideas.pitch: A localized environmental monitoring dashboard utilizing historical weather and satellite imagery to predict urban heat island intensity spikes across Atlanta neighborhoods.
ideas.title: Atlanta Urban Canopy Micro-Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines time-series forecasting with environmental data science, echoing the rigorous modeling approach seen in top-tier winning projects.
